name: slider
title: Slider
description: A value along a 4px track filled brand blue, with a white 16px thumb; two thumbs pick a range.
usage: Choose a number where the rough position matters more than the exact value (a monthly budget, a crawl depth, a confidence threshold). Show the value beside it in a label, and give it an aria-label or a labelled heading. Pass two values for a range.
avoid: A slider for exact numbers (use an input)
A slider without its value shown
Animating the thumb to its position

reference.source: Extrapolated from context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/switch.tsx (the pale off track, the brand blue and the white thumb)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
